name: fmsg
description: Federated, threaded messaging through the fmsg Web API.

fmsg.label: fmsg
fmsg.description: fmsg Web API connection, access control, and loop protection.

apiUrl.description: Explicit fmsg Web API base URL; no hosted endpoint is assumed.

apiKey.description: fmsg API key or OpenClaw SecretRef. FMSG_API_KEY takes precedence.

maxAgentTurnsPerThread.description: Automatic OpenClaw turns allowed per fmsg branch/window; 0 disables the circuit breaker.

maxAgentTurnsPerRoot.description: Automatic OpenClaw turns allowed across all branches of one fmsg root/window; 0 disables this circuit breaker.

maxAgentTurnsPerSender.description: Automatic OpenClaw turns allowed for one normalized fmsg sender/window across all roots; 0 disables this circuit breaker.

agentTurnWindowMs.description: Sliding automatic-turn window in milliseconds shared by branch, root, and sender circuit breakers.

reactions.description: Allow the shared OpenClaw message tool to add, change, clear, and list fmsg reactions.

reactionNotifications.description: Surface no reactions, reactions to agent-authored messages, or reactions to all known messages.
